name: Smartsheet
description: Project management: enterprise work management platform built around spreadsheet-like sheets, reports, dashboards and workflow automation.
access_notes: API access tokens can be generated self-serve in the UI (Personal Settings > API Access), but the API is restricted to licensed users on Business and Enterprise plans. Developer Tools registration at developers.smartsheet.com/register is only for registering OAuth apps and itself requires an email belonging to an existing licensed user on a Business plan or higher; the previously offered free developer sandbox account registration is no longer advertised. Production use requires a paid Business/Enterprise plan (trial of a qualifying plan also works).
mcp_notes: Official Smartsheet MCP Server is generally available at https://mcp.smartsheet.com (OAuth 2.0 or personal access token; requires Business/Enterprise plan), documented at developers.smartsheet.com/ai-mcp. No Composio Smartsheet toolkit found (docs.composio.dev/toolkits/smartsheet returns 404 and the toolkit catalog does not list it).
uncertainty_notes: Some API endpoints (user management, event reporting) are further restricted to Enterprise/Advanced Work Management plans with support activation. The old developer registration page (register/index.html) that offered a free developer sandbox account now 404s; the current Developer Tools Registration page covers only OAuth app registration and requires an existing licensed Business+ user, so it is unclear whether a free sandbox program still exists in any form.

evidence.note: REST API authenticates with access tokens (API keys) generated in the UI, passed as Authorization: Bearer; OAuth 2.0 3-legged flow recommended for user-consent scenarios.
OAuth 2.0 authorization_code flow with scopes (including ADMIN_WEBHOOKS for webhook management) and refresh tokens via POST /token.

Developer Tools Registration (OAuth app registration only): 'The email address used to register for Developer Tools must belong to an existing licensed Smartsheet user on a Business plan or higher'; no registration needed for direct API access via access tokens.
'The Smartsheet API is restricted to users on Business and Enterprise plans'; OpenAPI reference covers sheets, rows, users, webhooks and more (read+write).
Official Smartsheet MCP server docs on the vendor developer portal.
Vendor announcement: MCP Server GA; requires a Business or Enterprise plan; OAuth 2.0 or personal access token.
